Notes: ROUND AN - THE VILLAGE GROUND (Anthony, 6 Oct): the town, the church, the farm, the beer tent, the clubhouse, trees and a few locals round the pitch. Built from data/VillageGround.csv by tools/make_village.py out of PixelLab parts in art_source/pixellab/village/; every part is its own layer in art_source/aseprite/stadium.aseprite. SAME SIZE AS THE PITCH (2560 x 1440) AND PARALLAX 0, so the houses stay put next to the grass when the camera moves. The wide shot shows all of it (camera_wide_ground in Tuning.csv). The round AN top-down stadium it replaced is in art_source/legacy/field/. Leave Image blank for no background

THE PLAYING SURFACE, made by tools/make_pitch.py: PixelLab grass, the lines drawn by ruler. ROUND AN: THE WHITE LINES ARE THE EDGE OF THE PLAYER ZONES - at 2560 x 1440 they run x 436-2124 and y 288-1152. That is the first camera view (1920 x 1080, centred) pulled in by pitch_inset_x and pitch_inset_y in Tuning.csv. Change either row and run make_pitch.py again so the lines follow. Only a strip of run-off grass goes round the lines; the rest of the picture is see-through so the village shows. Draw it 2560 x 1440 (16:9). The old pitch is in art_source/legacy/field/

AN OVERLAY ON TOP OF EVERYTHING, for the Stadium screen to unlock later. Tint is multiplied over the layer, so a warm colour here is floodlights and a cold one is a night game. Requires works the same way it does everywhere else - blank means always on, and a row whose Requires fails is simply not drawn. No Image means this row does nothing yet

ROUND AN - THE FULL HOUSE FANS: packed terraces along both touchlines (PixelLab, art_source/pixellab/village/fans.png, rows with Layer crowd in data/VillageGround.csv). Shown once Full House is unlocked. Drawn between the village and the grass. Same size as the pitch, parallax 0
